name: global-tourism-analytics-hayya-morocco
what_it_holds: Committed UN Tourism / UNWTO outbound-departures Excel file (UN_Tourism_outbound_departures_12_2025.xlsx, dated Dec 2025) covering 1995-2030 (historical + UNWTO forecast horizon), plus a forecasting notebook (_Hayya_Morocco_tourism_Analytics.ipynb) built for the 2030 Hayya Morocco / 2030 World Cup tourism-demand context. MIT licence, updated 16 Apr 2026.
why_useful: A relatively fresh (Dec 2025 vintage) global outbound-tourism-departures snapshot with a forward path to 2030; could serve as an independent global travel-demand cross-check, and the forecasting methodology (applied to a global mega-event) is a loose analogue for the FIFA World Cup 2026 gap (#11).

name: TourVis

why_useful: If it contains bilateral tourist-flow matrices (origin-destination), that is a finer-grained dataset than aggregate arrivals counts and could support cross-border-share proxies (gap #20), but it is old (2022) and small.
